digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified wall-clock duration regressed from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes; decomposition shows macOS test work growth (+14m31s pytest), expensive unit test mechanics with real timeouts/sleeps, and xdist contention amplification as root causes, not mutation testing.

Mutation testing (landed e0b3fdfc8e) was selected in only 5/62 post-landing runs and did not extend the measured critical path; active-mutation runs averaged 33.0m wall while skipped runs averaged 36.5m, proving mutation is not the direct regression cause.

Seven specific unit tests execute expensive mechanics repeatedly: 120s missing-field timeout test, five captured 5s sleeps in jira-capability and dependency-audit, 25s retry backoff, 15s process timeouts, four redundant AST-parse guards (84.13s total), and per-xdist-worker wiki corpus cache fills (321.6–495.6s aggregate).

Pytest test count grew by ~4.1k selected default tests (91,205 net test lines added from ceea743 to main), and wiki-corpus lru_cache fills once per xdist worker instead of once per session, causing cache redundancy under parallelism.

Organization GitHub Free tier contention (20 total jobs/5 macOS limit) amplifies deterministic work nonlinearly; representative run queue median 0.72m with p90 13.53m, and macOS execution shows subprocess/APFS nonlinearity under contention rather than historical editor startup attribution.

Root cause confirmed through dated evidence, runtime profiles, and falsifiable experiments; remediation decomposed into seven linked tickets (albinic-kyanite-goldeneye, coed-defectible-muskox, analogical-dashing-fennecfox, harmless-wavy-osprey, curricular-mean-cuckoo, despotic-dorsal-greatdane, classless-dainty-lamprey) that preserve CI coverage and reject rejected parallelism; investigation complete with no code change required.
